text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Up next, we have the latest news<n>from the Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
First up is Mejiro Dober, a promising<n>rookie from
the Mejiro family, who<n>showed up strong in last
year's<n>Hanshin J.F.!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Her fans have high expectations for<n>her in the Tiara
tour...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since the start of the year, Mejiro<n>Dober has been
drawing far more<n>enthusiastic attention from the
public<n>than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I worry whether this attention will be<n>a good or bad
thing, as I head to the<n>academy to talk with her
about the<n>coming year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At the training course, I see Mejiro<n>Dober and
Mejiro Bright warming up<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober's trainer! Happy New Year!
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Dober's trainer! Happy New Year!
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Here's to another year together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'm looking forward to<n>working with you
again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's all make this year a wonderful<n>one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Let's all make this year a wonderful<n>one!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, it's Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: And she's with Mejiro Bright! How<n>lucky are we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's going on?!

Before we know what's happening,<n>a large group
of reporters starts<n>rushing toward us!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness. Are you here for an<n>interview? There
sure are a lot of<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Mejiro Dober! Could you<n>tell us about
your plans for your<n>classic year?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Since you ran in the Hanshin J.F.,<n>does that mean
you'll be aiming for<n>the Tiara tour? It's become a
hot<n>topic among your fans!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Is it true that you and Mejiro Bright<n>are secretly
training together for your<n>classic year?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Please give us all the details!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Uh...
choice_data_list: I'll take all your questions for now.

text_block_list.text: We'd prefer to hear from Mejiro<n>Dober herself!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please, Miss Dober! Your fans would<n>love to hear
what you have to—
choice_data_list: Please direct all inquiries through me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: But the world is longing to hear from<n>her directly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! My goodness, I seem to<n>have forgotten
something of mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Come with me, Dober! Keep me<n>company while I go
fetch it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wait! Please come back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I must take her with me.<n>I'm so
airheaded that I'll likely forget<n>more of my things
without Dober to<n>accompany me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh... Uh, y-yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thanks for that, Bright. And,uh... you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Thanks for that, Bright. Andthank you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? I only asked<n>you to come
with me to retrieve a<n>forgotten item.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Whatever do you mean? I only asked<n>you to come
with me to retrieve a<n>forgotten item.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You don't have to play dumb. If you<n>actually
forgot something, how come<n>you're
empty-handed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, actually, I seem to have<n>forgotten what it was
I had forgotten!<n>♪ What an airhead I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If you say so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, why were there so many<n>reporters around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Nothing like that has ever happened<n>before...
choice_data_list: It's proof of how many eyes are on you.
It's proof of how many eyes are on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...On me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural after your<n>performance in the
Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: With how exceptionally well you'vebeen doing, it'd be difficult not toattract attention.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I don't know about that, but... are<n>things going to be
like this forever?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Well, who can say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
But I'm sure your trainer will make it<n>abundantly
clear that unauthorized<n>interviews are not welcome.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: R-right...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems a bit<n>discombobulated after all
that. Maybe<n>she could do with a good change of
pace.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's, I suggest a
holiday-appropriate activity.
choice_data_list: Let's do some New Year's calligraphy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What?! Where'd that come from?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's gotten into you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Karuta? That sounds lovely!<n>The perfect
New Year's activity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Karuta? That sounds lovely!<n>The perfect
New Year's activity!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Bright! We still have to<n>train!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic! We used to play<n>karuta all together
as a family, and<n>Dober would cry because she
couldn't get any cards.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! That was back when I was<n>practically a
baby!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Last year, I did way better than you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, did you? Last year was so long<n>ago. I hardly
remember how things<n>went.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Grr... You're the one who brought up<n>ancient
history!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I suppose we'll just have to decide<n>who's better
with a rematch, then.<n>Let's get started, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh, fine... I'll play if you want to that<n>badly!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Okay, let's have your trainer<n>read the poems
for us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the day, Mejiro Dober<n>ends up in a
much better mood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Talk about sudden...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Mochi soup! What a wonderful<n>suggestion,
and a timely one too! I<n>was just starting to feel
peckish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Time to eat some stretchy, stretchy<n>mochi! Hehe!
What a happy thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I thought we were going to train,<n>thou—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
We should hurry and buy the<n>ingredients. Let's
see, for traditional<n>mochi soup, we'll need...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What kind of vegetables are in it<n>again? Celery?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh! Stop it right there, Bright! I'll help<n>make it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And you! Don't just stand there. This<n>was your
idea, so make yourself<n>useful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too confident in my cooking<n>skills, though,
so can you help us too,<n>Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I help the two of them make<n>Mejiro-style mochi
soup, and we all<n>eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I help the two of them make<n>Mejiro-style mochi
soup, and we all<n>eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not only does Mejiro Dober's mood<n>improve, I
also get to learn about<n>Mejiro-style cooking, so it's
a good<n>start to the new year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-New Year's calligraphy? What a<n>random
suggestion...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-New Year's calligraphy? We<n>weren't even
talking about that,<n>though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a marvelous idea! I haven't<n>done mine
yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a marvelous idea! I haven't<n>done mine
yet!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we take this opportunity to<n>write our
resolutions for the year,<n>Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure putting them on paper will<n>motivate us
even more in training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I guess we can do that... It'll be<n>embarrassing to
write them together,<n>though. My calligraphy's not
so<n>great...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What's important is the feeling<n>behind your words,
not the neatness.<n>Just pour your heart into the
brush<n>strokes, and all will be fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let's get started right away! Your<n>trainer should
join us too. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The three of us write our goals for the<n>classic year
and show them to each<n>other!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober seems focused, and I<n>sense
ambition in the letters she<n>pens: "Triple Tiara."
